name: bookbag
title: Bookbag
description: A primary-school corridor display board: dates and the regular week are white notices pinned to sunflower-yellow paper inside a scalloped royal-blue border.

tokens.--font-display: heavy sans: headings, name, menu, day figures, times
tokens.--color-bg: the corridor wall; lettering of the join link
tokens.--color-accent: links on the wall, current menu mark, join link
tokens.--color-frame: the blue scalloped border and the mark's dotted edge
tokens.--color-paper: the yellow backing paper; quotation bar
tokens.--color-notice-muted: secondary text on a notice, tear-off cuts
tokens.--color-notice-link: links and buttons on a notice
tokens.--color-red: red pins, the dates margin line, the cancelled stamp
tokens.--shadow-notice: laminate rim and shadow of a notice
tokens.--date-size: day figure in a dates row
tokens.--space-5: gap at the foot of the page
